rows.label: skyClouds is merged into BG (same object as BG_R78), reachable through overlay.js ALL_KINDS, with tags, doc and order, and the other backgrounds are still there
layers/manifest.json lists background.skyClouds with file layers/backgrounds-r78.js, tags, params, doc and this test (node make-manifests.mjs rewrites it)
defaults draw the clouds preset at 2 s (612 canvas calls, finite numbers, a sky gradient first)
defaults draw the dunes preset at 2 s (6662 canvas calls, finite numbers, a sky gradient first, one clipped ridge per layer)
skyClouds: 26 cloud-preset and 12 dunes-preset param variants all change the draw and stay finite
clouds 16:9: 60 times drawn forward and in shuffled order give identical draws, and twice in a row
dunes 16:9: 60 times drawn forward and in shuffled order give identical draws, and twice in a row
clouds 9:16: 60 times drawn forward and in shuffled order give identical draws, and twice in a row
dunes 9:16: 60 times drawn forward and in shuffled order give identical draws, and twice in a row
clouds 1:1: 60 times drawn forward and in shuffled order give identical draws, and twice in a row
dunes 1:1: 60 times drawn forward and in shuffled order give identical draws, and twice in a row
the same fingerprint (7 draws + field values) in this process and in two fresh processes: a pure function of t, no module state
cover is monotone: mean coverage 0.01 < 0.09 < 0.27 < 0.61 < 0.94 for cover 0 .. 1; 0 is clear (< 0.02) and 1 is mostly covered (> 0.75)
cover 0 draws no cloud (the sky and the sun only); cover > 0 draws them
cloudAt: the same point twice (with other points between) is the same, another seed is another field; cov and lit stay in 0..1
drift 0 freezes the clouds (the field at t = 1 and t = 81 is the same)
the drift is px per second at 1080: 108 px/s at scale 1 (three cells across the height) is 0.3 cells per second on the near layer and 0.55 x that on the far one; negative runs the other way
the clouds move: the density at one point changes over 20 s of drift, and lies in 0..1 over a grid
the light follows the sun: moving the sun from the left to the right or taking it away changes the shading of the clouds (not their coverage)
loop 2: frame t and t + 2 s are identical for both presets (6 times, grain included), the density and the dune crests match to 1e-9 / 1e-6, and a third of a loop later it is a different frame
loop 3: frame t and t + 3 s are identical for both presets (6 times, grain included), the density and the dune crests match to 1e-9 / 1e-6, and a third of a loop later it is a different frame
loop 5: frame t and t + 5 s are identical for both presets (6 times, grain included), the density and the dune crests match to 1e-9 / 1e-6, and a third of a loop later it is a different frame
loop 6: frame t and t + 6 s are identical for both presets (6 times, grain included), the density and the dune crests match to 1e-9 / 1e-6, and a third of a loop later it is a different frame
loop 7.3: frame t and t + 7.3 s are identical for both presets (6 times, grain included), the density and the dune crests match to 1e-9 / 1e-6, and a third of a loop later it is a different frame
loop 10: frame t and t + 10 s are identical for both presets (6 times, grain included), the density and the dune crests match to 1e-9 / 1e-6, and a third of a loop later it is a different frame
without loop: frame t and t + 6 s differ (the drift keeps going)
loop: each layer drifts a whole number of lattice periods per loop (near and far), at least one
band limit: the finest kept octave has a wavelength of at least 3 samples for every grid size (24-256), scale (0.2-5) and aspect (the smallest is 3.00 samples)
no shimmer: the largest change of density between two frames at 60 fps is 0.0017 at the default drift (limit 0.005) and 0.0152 at 400 px/s (limit 0.03), over a 64 x 36 grid

dunes: every crest line is continuous (no step over 20 px between 200 columns at 1080p) and inside the frame; the mean crest height falls from far (696 px) to near (953 px): the near dunes are lower in the frame
relief 0 flattens the crest lines (a constant y)
wind 0 freezes the dunes; the wind is faster on the near ridges (parallax)
the light face follows the sun side (sun left and sun right shade the dunes differently)
ridges draws that many clipped layers (1, 3, 6)
unique per item: the draw emits no ids (no url(#...), clipPath, filter), and two layers of the same kind on one page (clouds and dunes, rendered in turn) draw exactly what each would alone
guards: 17 numeric parameters x 8 hostile values x both presets never throw, never hang (< 4 s each), stay finite, and draw at most 7964 canvas calls (cap 40000: cells <= 256, ridges <= 6)

guards: NaN, +-Infinity, a non-numeric string, '', null, undefined, an object, an array or a boolean for any of the 17 numeric parameters throws nothing and draws exactly the default (the pack-wide sanitising policy)
guards: a numeric string is read as the number (every numeric parameter)

guards: a colour that is not #RGB / #RRGGBB, a sky with fewer than 2 colours, a bad sand or sun colour throws a clear error naming skyClouds; #RGB shorthand is accepted; more than 3 sky colours use the first 3
guards: t that is NaN or infinite throws; a zero, negative or NaN frame size throws; t = 1e9 and t = -1e9 draw finite numbers

skyParams clamps: cells 1e9 -> 256, ridges 99 -> 6, grain 5 -> 1, height 9 -> 0.9, cover 7 -> 1; the defaults come back unchanged; the preset sets cover and sun when cover is -1 / sun is null (clouds 0.55, dunes 0.16); colours become RGB triples
clouds: mounted via mountStack (skyClouds), bit-identical at t 1 after rendering t 0.37
clouds, later in the drift: mounted via mountStack (skyClouds), bit-identical at t 9 after rendering t 0.37
overcast (cover 0.9, softness 0.8): mounted via mountStack (skyClouds), bit-identical at t 3 after rendering t 0.37

dusk sky, big clouds: mounted via mountStack (skyClouds), bit-identical at t 3 after rendering t 0.37

dunes, later in the wind: mounted via mountStack (skyClouds), bit-identical at t 9 after rendering t 0.37
dunes, sun on the right: mounted via mountStack (skyClouds), bit-identical at t 1 after rendering t 0.37
dunes, loop 6 at t = 6: mounted via mountStack (skyClouds), bit-identical at t 6 after rendering t 0.37
pixels, clear sky: the horizon band (mean luma 211.5) is lighter than the top band (159.6): the gradient runs top to horizon
skyClouds (dunes + clouds): pixels identical when the same 6 times are rendered again in shuffled order
skyClouds clouds loop 6: real pixels at t and t + 6 s are identical (5 times)
skyClouds dunes loop 6: real pixels at t and t + 6 s are identical (5 times)
skyClouds (dunes + clouds) at 1080p (includes the 1 px read-back): 31.8 ms per frame (budget 400 ms)
no console errors
